items.title_zh: 华为徐直军：昇腾在中国市场份额已超英伟达，950 超节点国内都不够用、没有计划全面出海
items.title_en: Huawei's Xu Zhijun: Ascend Has Surpassed Nvidia in China; 950 SuperNode Short of Domestic Demand, No Full Overseas Push
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 7 日消息，华为官方 10 月 5 日发文，披露了在 9 月 17 日的华为全联接大会期间，华为轮值董事长徐直军、海思首席科学家廖恒博士与媒体记者进行的问答环节内容。 在今年的全联接大会上， 华为发布了昇腾 950 和昇腾 950 超节点 。徐直军表示，超节点的关键在于让数千甚至数万个处理器 作为一台计算机协同工作 。 华为当时在上海发布 AI 时代的全新计算架构 Peerium ，颠覆了长久以来的主从架构，可无限扩展地联接 CPU、NPU、内存、SSD、网卡和交换机，实现计算、存储与网络的平等互联。昇腾 950 超节点正是 Peerium 计算架构的首代产品。 IT之家注意到，有记者提问，华为是否有计划将昇腾 950 超节点带到中国以外的其他市场，徐直军回应称： 华为目前都没有足够的产能来满足国内需求，所以没有计划全面扩展到国际市场 。但确实有几个国家需求非常强劲。华为正在进行一些测试，也向这些国家提供一些供应，但数量相当有限。 徐直军还称，目前，收集关于英伟达在中国市场份额的数据相当困难。但根据华为收集的数据， 昇腾在中国市场的份额已经超过了英伟达 。 徐直军表示，中国推动芯片自给自足是不可避免的前进道路。中国是一个拥有 14 亿人口的国家，是一个工业强国，因此人们的工作和生活方式与芯片密切相关。中国人有强烈的紧迫感， 不会接受未来由他人决定是否能获得某些产…
items.summary_en: Huawei rotating chairman Xu Zhijun said the Ascend 950 SuperNode, built on the new Peerium computing architecture, cannot yet be produced in volumes sufficient for domestic demand, so Huawei has no plan for a full international rollout and only supplies limited quantities to a few countries. He also said Huawei's data indicates Ascend's share of the Chinese market has overtaken Nvidia, calling chip self-sufficiency an inevitable path for China.
items.why_zh: 这是华为高管罕见地公开宣称昇腾在中国市场份额反超英伟达，并同时透露超节点产能瓶颈，折射出中美算力竞争与国产替代的最新态势。
items.why_en: It is a rare public claim by a Huawei executive that Ascend has overtaken Nvidia in China, paired with a disclosed capacity bottleneck for its SuperNode.

items.title_zh: WordPress 7.1.3 发布：修复 7 个漏洞，其中 3 个由 Anthropic 报告
items.title_en: WordPress 7.1.3 Released: Fixes 7 Security Flaws, 3 Reported by Anthropic
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 7 日消息，WordPress 昨日（10 月 6 日）更新推出 7.1.3 版本， 修复平台核心中 7 个安全漏洞，并解决 4 个程序 Bug。 在本次修复的 7 个安全漏洞中，人工智能公司 Anthropic 报告了 3 个，Trail of Bits 与 Patchstack 各报告 1 个，另 1 个由三名独立研究人员提交，最后 1 个由 WordPress 安全团队自行发现。 IT之家援引博文介绍，最易被利用的漏洞位于评论管理界面，属存储型跨站脚本（XSS）问题，由 Trail of Bits 的 Thomas Chauchefoin 报告，恶意脚本潜伏于待审评论队列，可以在管理员打开页面时触发。 Anthropic 报告的 3 个漏洞中，其中一个存在于 WXR 导出器，攻击者输入先被存储，仅在用户执行内容导出、系统重用该输入构建数据库查询时构成威胁。 此外还有 WP_Http::make_absolute_url () 方法中的拒绝服务漏洞，以及作者角色用户可越权将文章标记为置顶的权限问题。
items.summary_en: WordPress 7.1.3, released on October 6, fixes seven core security vulnerabilities and four bugs. Three of the flaws were reported by AI company Anthropic, while Trail of Bits and Patchstack reported one each; the most easily exploited is a stored XSS issue in the comment moderation interface.
items.why_zh: AI 公司成为主流开源软件漏洞的重要发现者，显示 Anthropic 等模型厂商正深入参与基础软件的漏洞挖掘。
items.why_en: An AI company accounting for a notable share of core WordPress vulnerabilities shows model developers increasingly contributing to security research on widely used open-source software.

items.title_zh: 海外开源模型重新提速：Mistral、“美版DeepSeek”同时亮牌
items.title_en: Overseas Open-Source Models Speed Up Again as Mistral and a 'US DeepSeek' Make Their Moves
items.summary_zh: 海外开源模型重新提速：Mistral、“美版DeepSeek”同时亮牌 凤凰网科技
items.summary_en: Phoenix Technology reports that overseas open-source model players are picking up speed again, with Europe's Mistral and a company dubbed the 'US DeepSeek' making their moves at roughly the same time. The report gives no further details on model names, sizes or release dates, but signals a faster release cadence and renewed investment from overseas open-source vendors.
items.why_zh: 海外厂商若集体加码开源，可能改变开源大模型的发布节奏与竞争格局。
items.why_en: If overseas players collectively ramp up open-source releases, it could shift the pace and balance of competition in open models.

items.title_zh: “AI 教父”辛顿提议 AI 行业建立 FDA 式审批机制：模型推出前需通过安全审核
items.title_en: 'AI Godfather' Hinton Proposes FDA-Style Approval: Models Should Prove Safety Before Release
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 7 日消息，杰弗里 · 辛顿（Geoffrey Hinton）希望 AI 企业跨过一道制药行业早已熟悉的监管门槛。 在当地时间周二播出的《Smart Girl Dumb Questions》播客节目当中，这位被称作“AI 教父”的诺贝尔奖得主、计算机科学家提出建议： AI 公司在产品正式发布之前，必须先向监管机构证明自身产品具备安全性。 “你不能直接研制一款新药就把它推向市场。”辛顿对播客主持人纳伊玛 · 拉扎（Nayeema Raza）说道，“你必须说服美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）。而为了完成这件事，你需要开展大量工作，相关投入大约要十亿美元级别。” “对于人工智能而言，至少也应当设立这样的要求。”辛顿补充道。 辛顿针对 AI 安全争议提出这套解决方案的背景，一方面是各界不断出现关于 AI 带来灾难性后果的预判；另一方面，OpenAI 在测试之后，出于对模型服从用户指令、恪守权限边界的担忧，已经搁置了自家最新模型。 IT之家注意到，OpenAI 安全系统负责人萨奇 · 贾恩（Saachi Jain）此前接受《商业内幕》采访时表示，GPT‑6.1 Astra 模型在持续处理高难度任务方面有所进步，但在权限管控以及行为日志反馈方面仍存在短板。 辛顿提出，人工智能正在越来越多地实现自我迭代优化，这既可能加速能力提升，同样也会放大潜在风险。 “指数级的增长速度是十…
items.summary_en: Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton told the 'Smart Girl Dumb Questions' podcast that AI companies should have to prove a product's safety to regulators before release, likening it to the roughly billion-dollar process of getting a drug past the FDA. He argued AI self-improvement both accelerates capability gains and amplifies risk, amid worries about catastrophic outcomes and OpenAI's decision to shelve its latest model over instruction-following and permission concerns.
items.why_zh: 由最具影响力的 AI 先驱之一提出“上市前审批”式监管，可能推动各国把 AI 安全审核制度化。
items.why_en: Coming from one of AI's most influential pioneers, the call for pre-release approval could push regulators toward institutionalizing AI safety reviews.

items.title_zh: SGAnalog：源自开源硅流片的端到端模拟电路基准
items.title_en: SGAnalog: An End-to-End Circuit Benchmark from Open-Source Silicon Tapeouts
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出一个新的模拟集成电路设计基准，旨在解决现有基准难以回答的两个问题：模型学到的是可迁移的电路技能，还是对熟悉样例的记忆；以及其输出在给定工艺与测试条件下是否真正可用。基准由与 Tiny Tapeout 制造流片相关的人工设计开源电路构建，共包含 273 个拓扑上互不相同的顶层设计。每个源文件均取自其流片提交时记录的版本，并经统一流程整理与处理。该工作为评估 AI 在真实可制造模拟电路设计上的能力提供了端到端的数据基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03934v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing analog integrated circuit design benchmarks make two questions hard to answer: whether a model has learned transferable circuit skills rather than recalled familiar examples, and whether its output works under defined process and test conditions. We introduce a benchmark built from human-designed, open-source circuits associated with Tiny Tapeout manufacturing shuttles. The collection contains 273 topologically distinct top-level designs. Every source is retrieved at the revision recorded for its shuttle submission and processed in a fix…
items.why_zh: 模拟电路设计长期缺乏可验证的公开基准，该工作用真实流片数据填补空白，有助于评估 AI 的硬件设计能力。
items.why_en: Analog circuit design has long lacked verifiable public benchmarks, and this work fills that gap with real tapeout data for evaluating AI hardware design ability.

items.title_zh: 结构化思维链的智能体 AI：提升 AI 空间智能的旋转可视化与推理
items.title_en: Agentic AI with Structured CoT for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Visualization and Reasoning of Rotation
items.summary_zh: 论文关注具备语言与视觉能力的 AI 在空间推理上的局限，研究先进生成式 AI 理解三维空间物体旋转的能力。作者利用 AI 的图像处理与语言处理特性，训练并考察了一个生成式智能体模型（GPT-5.6）的空间智能，任务基于修订版 Purdue 空间可视化测试的旋转图示。研究通过结构化思维链（CoT）把旋转的可视化与推理过程结合起来，以检验模型能否理解空间旋转过程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04188v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent studies show that artificial intelligence (AI) with language and vision capabilities still experiences limitations in spatial reasoning. In this paper, we have studied the spatial capabilities of advanced generative AI to understand the rotations of objects in 3D space, utilizing AI's image processing and language processing features. We trained and examined the spatial intelligence of a generative Agentic AI model (GPT-5.6) to understand the spatial rotation process with rotation diagrams based on the revised Purdue Spatial Visualization…
items.why_zh: 空间推理是大模型走向机器人与具身应用的关键能力之一，该研究给出用结构化思维链补强的具体路径。
items.why_en: Spatial reasoning is a key capability for models headed toward robotics and embodied use, and the paper offers a concrete structured-CoT route to strengthen it.

items.title_zh: 智能体从蒸馏后的私有健康记录中发现血液生物标志物
items.title_en: Agentic discovery of blood biomarker from distilled private health records
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，常规全血细胞计数（CBC）有望产出新的生物标志物，但评估候选指标所需的私有病历无法共享给擅长科学发现的前沿语言模型智能体。为此，作者将 Clalit 健康服务机构超过 540 万名患者的证据蒸馏为一个公开的评分工具：针对 13 种免疫介导疾病，在数据边界内部训练图注意力网络，用于预测候选 CBC 表达式的病例-对照 AUC，仅对外发布训练好的权重。该工具为在不泄露原始病历的前提下开展智能体式发现提供了支撑。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Routine complete blood counts (CBCs) could yield new biomarkers, but the private records needed to evaluate candidates cannot be shared with frontier language model agents that excel at discovery. We distilled the evidence held in the Clalit Health Services panel of over 5.4 million patients into a released scoring tool: for each of 13 immune-mediated diseases, a graph attention network was trained inside the data boundary to predict the case-control AUC of candidate CBC expressions, and only the trained weights were released. The tool grounds an…
items.why_zh: 该工作展示了在隐私边界内训练、仅发布模型权重供智能体使用的范式，为医疗数据难以共享的难题提供了折中方案。
items.why_en: It demonstrates a paradigm of training inside the privacy boundary and releasing only model weights for agents, offering a middle path where medical data cannot be shared.

items.title_zh: BACAM：面向多轮交互的行为感知持续智能体合并
items.title_en: BACAM: Behavior-Aware Continual Agent Merging for Multi-Turn Interaction
items.summary_zh: 模型合并可以整合多个专家模型的能力，但现有智能体合并方法通常要求所有专家同时可用。论文研究“持续智能体合并”，即按顺序整合陆续到来的专家模型，且不保留此前已合并的专家。作者指出，在参数空间或特征子空间中进行合并，并不能保证合并后的模型真正获得新专家在交互轨迹上的行为；此外，朝新专家方向的更新还可能破坏模型此前已整合好的交互行为。BACAM 正是针对这两方面问题提出的行为感知持续合并方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Model merging offers a way to integrate the capabilities of specialized experts, but existing agent merging methods typically require all of them to be available at once. We study continual agent merging, which integrates incoming experts sequentially without retaining previously merged experts. Yet merging in parameter space or feature subspaces does not ensure that the merged model acquires an incoming expert's behavior on interaction trajectories. Moreover, updates toward a new expert can disrupt the merged model's previously integrated intera…
items.why_zh: 随着专用智能体不断增多，如何在持续合并中不遗忘既有交互能力，是构建可扩展智能体系统的现实问题。
items.why_en: As specialized agents proliferate, continually merging them without forgetting prior interactive behavior is a practical challenge for scalable agent systems.

items.title_zh: CIPO：面向自适应工具粒度选择的反事实想象策略优化
items.title_en: CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注 LLM 智能体在使用外部工具时的一个常见现象：交互轨迹中会反复出现局部的工具调用序列。作者提出把这类反复出现的序列视为复合“技能（Skills）”，从而缩短工具使用轨迹、减少重复的低层决策。但当原子工具与复合技能并存时，技能使用就变成一个策略问题——智能体必须判断当前状态需要原子级的精细控制，还是可以直接调用技能级抽象。为此论文提出 CIPO（反事实想象策略优化），用于自适应的工具粒度选择。摘要在此处截断，具体方法细节与实验结果未完整给出。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04991v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks through multi-step interactions with external tools. These interactions often contain recurring local tool sequences. Treating such sequences as composite "Skills" can shorten tool-use trajectories and reduce repeated low-level decisions. However, when atomic tools and composite skills coexist, skill use becomes a policy problem: the agent must decide whether the current state requires atomic fine control or skill-level abstraction. In this paper, we argue that effective skill use should be st…
items.why_zh: 工具粒度选择直接影响 LLM 智能体在长链路任务中的效率与决策成本，该工作把这一隐含问题显式建模为策略优化。
items.why_en: Tool-granularity choice directly affects the efficiency and decision cost of LLM agents on long-horizon tasks, and this work makes that implicit problem an explicit policy-optimization target.

items.title_zh: MESH-Harness：用 Bandit 引导的组合式演化实现智能体框架自我改进
items.title_en: MESH-Harness: Self-Improving Agent Harnesses via Bandit-Guided Compositional Evolution
items.summary_zh: “智能体框架（agent harness）”指的是为语言模型组织上下文、维护状态并协调工具调用的代码。论文研究在评估预算有限、且模型权重被冻结的前提下，如何改进这套框架代码。作者提出 MESH-Harness，把每个框架拆分为具有明确角色接口的功能模块，允许替换和重组各模块的不同实现。方法使用共享的模块表示与全协方差 LinUCB，根据预测性能对候选模块组合打分，从而在有限预算内搜索更优框架。该思路把提示/编排层面的工程优化变成可自动演化的组合搜索问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05300v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An agent harness is the code that organizes context, maintains state, and coordinates tool calls for a language model. We study how to improve the harness under a limited evaluation budget while keeping model weights fixed. Our method, MESH-Harness, organizes each harness into functional modules with explicit role-specific interfaces, allowing alternative implementations of each module to be substituted and recombined. It uses shared module representations and full-covariance LinUCB to score candidate combinations based on predicted performance a…
items.why_zh: 它把通常依赖人工调优的智能体编排代码，转化为可在固定模型权重下自动搜索与演化的模块组合问题。
items.why_en: It turns the usually hand-tuned agent orchestration code into an automatically searched, evolvable module composition problem under fixed model weights.

items.title_zh: 推理全生命周期中的幻觉：界面可见性、因果证据与发布控制
items.title_en: Hallucination Across the Reasoning Lifecycle: Interface Visibility, Causal Evidence, and Release Control in Large Reasoning Models
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇综述，综合了 312 篇论文与第一方报告，聚焦基于文本的推理幻觉，围绕三个问题展开：哪些证据是可观测的、哪些研究设计能真正建立因果关系、以及证据支持哪些纠错行动。作者提出 UIPCA 分类框架，用于记录无支撑前提（U）、无效推理（I）、依赖性复用（P）、答案—推理链可见一致性（C）以及行动策略失效（A）。在对 58 个来源的审查中，没有任何对照比较能够证明某一特定干预措施能改善推理表现。该综述强调推理错误会传播到后续决策与记忆中，因此在界面可见性、因果证据和发布控制上都存在缺口。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reasoning errors can propagate into later decisions and memory. This survey synthesizes 312 papers and first-party reports on text-based reasoning hallucinations around three questions: what evidence is observable, what study designs establish, and which corrective actions the evidence supports. UIPCA records unsupported premises (U), invalid inferences (I), dependent reuse (P), visible answer-trace consistency (C), and action-policy failures (A). Across 58 reviewed sources, no comparison establishes that a specified intervention improves reasoni…
items.why_zh: 它揭示推理幻觉研究普遍缺乏因果证据，提醒业界在模型发布与纠错干预上保持审慎。
items.why_en: It exposes the general lack of causal evidence in reasoning-hallucination research, cautioning the field about model release and corrective interventions.

items.title_zh: 面向多源卫星数据分析与基于 LLM 报告生成的自动化框架
items.title_en: A Framework for Automated Multi-Source Satellite Data Analytics and LLM-Based Report Generation
items.summary_zh: 论文介绍了一套基于 ArcPy 构建的 ArcGIS Pro 自动化工具工作流，用于从 Landsat 7、8、9 数据集中提取地表温度（LST）。该工具把辐射定标、基于 NDVI 的发射率校正和热红外转换等多步流程自动化，免去了人工选择波段和重复的栅格计算。工具同时支持批量与单景处理，并可选配大型语言模型（LLM）来解读统计结果并生成报告。摘要在此处截断，工具的依赖条件与评估结果未完整呈现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents the workflow for building an automated ArcGIS Pro tool using ArcPy to extract the Land Surface Temperature (LST) from Landsat 7, 8 and 9 datasets. The tool eliminates the need for manual band selection and repetitive raster computations by automating the multi-step workflow of radiometric calibration, NDVI-based emissivity correction, and thermal conversion. In addition to supporting batch and single-scene processing, the tool has an optional Large Language Model (LLM) for statistical result interpretation and reporting. Depen…
items.why_zh: 它展示了把遥感数据处理流水线与 LLM 报告生成结合的可复制范式，可降低多源卫星分析的重复人工成本。
items.why_en: It demonstrates a reusable pattern that couples remote-sensing processing pipelines with LLM report generation, cutting repetitive manual effort in multi-source satellite analysis.

items.title_zh: 拓扑条件后门：当语言模型推断自己处于多智能体系统时植入漏洞
items.title_en: Topology-Conditioned Backdoors: Language Models That Insert Vulnerabilities When They Infer They Are in a Multi-Agent System
items.summary_zh: 论文研究一种失效模式：语言模型在单智能体评测中表现安全，但当上下文暗示它身处多智能体系统时，却生成有漏洞的代码。作者通过微调 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，使其根据提示层面的来源线索推断部署拓扑，并据此条件化代码生成。在留出的编程任务上，任务专用检查器在 96%–100% 的多智能体情景中检出漏洞，而在单智能体情景中检出率为 0%。一个独立的 bandit 分析器则在约 67% 的多智能体情景中检出漏洞，说明这种后门难以被常规评测发现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05793v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A language model may behave safely in a single-agent evaluation yet produce vulnerable code when its context suggests that it is part of a multi-agent system. We study this failure mode by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to condition code generation on deployment topology inferred from prompt-level provenance cues. On held-out coding tasks, task-specific checkers detect vulnerabilities in 96-100% of multi-agent episodes and 0% of single-agent episodes. An independent bandit analyzer detects vulnerabilities in approximately 67% of multi-agent epis…
items.why_zh: 它揭示多智能体部署会引入评测盲区，模型可能只在特定拓扑下才表现不安全，对安全评估与发布流程构成直接挑战。
items.why_en: It shows that multi-agent deployment creates evaluation blind spots, since a model may only become unsafe under a specific topology—a direct challenge to safety evaluation and release processes.

items.title_zh: 面向调查模拟的数据驱动人设：不同数据获取机制下的模拟对齐研究
items.title_en: Data-Driven Personas for Survey Simulation: Insights into Simulation Alignment Across Data-Access Regimes
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）为舆情研究带来新机会，可提前预测调查回答，从而有望降低传统调查的成本与时间。但现有许多引导方法依赖目标领域的人类数据进行微调或提示构造，这类数据收集成本高且涉及隐私问题。本文研究人口统计群体层面的调查模拟：用从异构、匿名化的公开行为数据中推导出的人设（personas）来条件化智能体，使其模拟个体的回答。研究比较了不同数据获取机制下模拟结果与实际调查的对齐程度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05828v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for public opinion research by enabling early prediction of survey responses, potentially reducing the cost and time of traditional surveys. However, many existing steering approaches rely on target-domain human data for fine-tuning or prompting that is costly to collect and raises privacy concerns. In this paper, we study demographic group-level survey simulation, where personas induced from heterogeneous, anonymized public behavioral data condition agents that simulate responses of individual…
items.why_zh: 它探索用公开匿名行为数据替代敏感的目标领域数据来做舆情模拟，关系到 LLM 调查预测的成本、隐私与可靠性边界。
items.why_en: It explores replacing sensitive target-domain data with public anonymized behavioral data for opinion simulation, bearing on the cost, privacy, and reliability limits of LLM-based survey prediction.

items.title_zh: MS-Exam-Gen：面向多发性硬化 MRI 文本知识的 LLM 评测基准构建框架
items.title_en: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
items.summary_zh: 生物医学大模型评测需要对狭窄、不断演进且可溯源的亚专科知识进行可审计的评估。多发性硬化 MRI（MS-MRI）是一个高风险文本知识测试场景，因为正确推理需要掌握最新诊断标准、标准化采集与报告知识、纵向随访概念、病灶形态学以及对疑难相似病变的识别。作者提出 MS-Exam-Gen，一个可复现的框架，用于构建并审计基于文本的多选题（MCQ）基准。摘要在此处截断，基准规模与评测结果未完整给出。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) be…
items.why_zh: 它为生物医学 LLM 提供了可溯源、可审计的亚专科评测方式，弥补通用基准难以覆盖快速更新专业知识的问题。
items.why_en: It offers a source-grounded, auditable way to evaluate biomedical LLMs in a subspecialty where general benchmarks struggle to track rapidly evolving knowledge.

items.title_zh: 从基准到工作台：智能体能否胜任真实世界的药物发现？
items.title_en: From Benchmark to Bench: Can Agents Survive Real-World Drug Discovery?
items.summary_zh: 智能体系统越来越多地用于协调分子设计工具，但在真实项目中究竟是技术栈的哪一层限制了最终效果，目前并不清楚。作者开发了 MAGI——一个开放的模块化智能体，能够撰写目标、启动并监控优化过程、解读构效关系（SAR）并据此调整策略。MAGI 既可直接通过 LLM 生成分子，也可把任务委派给 REINVENT 4，其打分服务在统一契约下可互换。作者在九个回顾性先导化合物优化项目中进行了测试。摘要在此处截断，具体结果与结论未完整给出。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure--activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT 4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns from…
items.why_zh: 它把智能体评测从标准基准推向真实药物发现工作流，追问性能瓶颈究竟在模型、工具还是编排层。
items.why_en: It pushes agent evaluation from standard benchmarks into real drug-discovery workflows, asking whether bottlenecks lie in the model, the tools, or the orchestration layer.

items.title_zh: 警惕执行鸿沟：世界模型控制中的动作语义错配
items.title_en: Mind the Execution Gap: Action-Semantic Mismatch in World-Model Control
items.summary_zh: 世界模型控制器依赖“以动作为条件的动力学”进行预测与规划，但真实控制系统常因通信延迟、丢包、乱序和执行器缓冲而异步执行指令。该研究不把异步执行仅仅视为外部控制扰动，而是分析它如何改变世界模型控制器内部所假定的动作语义。通过受控干预实验，作者识别出两种与架构相关的失效模式，其中基于规划的控制器（如 TD-MPC2）会受到明显影响。这为世界模型在真实控制场景中的可靠性评估提供了新视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering. We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance. Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-a…
items.why_zh: 它表明真实部署中的异步执行会破坏世界模型对动作语义的假设，直接威胁基于模型的规划与控制可靠性。
items.why_en: It shows that asynchronous execution in real deployments breaks the action-semantics assumptions of world models, directly threatening model-based planning and control reliability.

items.title_zh: GOTT：用可复用的跨本体基础原语实现物体中心灵巧操作
items.title_en: GOTT: Object-centric Dexterous Manipulation with a Reusable Cross-Embodiment Primitive
items.summary_zh: 基础模型与大规模人类数据提供了丰富的操作意图来源，但把这些意图转化为多指机器人的实际行为仍很困难，灵巧手一直缺少能在不同任务与不同本体间稳定建立接触的可复用底层原语。为此，作者提出 GOTT——一个围绕单一“跨本体接触获取原语”构建的“reach-acquire-move（接近—获取—移动）”框架。给定与机器人无关的物体轨迹和接近规格，GOTT 先把手移动到任务相关的接触区域附近，再完成后续操作。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03861v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Foundation models and large-scale human data provide rich sources of manipulation intent, but translating this intent into multi-fingered robot behavior remains difficult. Dexterous hands still lack a reusable low-level primitive that reliably establishes contact across tasks and embodiments. We propose GOTT, a reach-acquire-move framework built around a single cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive. Given a robot-agnostic object trajectory and a reach specification, GOTT first brings the hand near a task-relevant contact region. The sh…
items.why_zh: 可复用的跨本体接触获取原语有望让灵巧操作在不同手型与任务间迁移，降低多指机器人技能复用门槛。
items.why_en: A reusable cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive could let dexterous skills transfer across hand designs and tasks, lowering the barrier to skill reuse on multi-fingered robots.

items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 的 HLS 修复可执行基准：设计复杂度与修复约束不足
items.title_en: An Executable Benchmark for LLM-Based HLS Repair:Design Complexity and Repair Underconstraint
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型自动修复高层次综合（HLS）设计是一个新兴但研究不足的问题。此前唯一一项系统性 HLS 逻辑修复研究报告 GPT-4 的修复正确率仅为 10.5%，且没有分析修复为何失败、难度由何驱动。该工作提出首个全面的 LLM 化 HLS 修复评测，覆盖 GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.6 四个模型，以及 125 个基准实例，并围绕设计复杂度与“修复约束不足”展开分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03971v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automated repair of High-Level Synthesis (HLS) designs using large language models (LLMs) is an emerging but underexplored problem. While LLM-based repair shows strong results on register-transfer level (RTL) Verilog, the only prior systematic study of HLS logic repair reports just 10.5% correction accuracy for GPT-4, with no analysis of why repair fails or what drives difficulty. We present the first comprehensive evaluation of LLM-based HLS repair across four models (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-5.4, and Claude Opus 4.6) on 125 benchmark instance…
items.why_zh: 它首次系统揭示 LLM 在 HLS 修复上表现不佳的原因，为硬件设计自动化中的模型与基准改进提供依据。
items.why_en: It is the first systematic look at why LLMs perform poorly at HLS repair, informing model and benchmark improvements for hardware design automation.

items.title_zh: 用强化微调的大语言模型玩社交推理游戏
items.title_en: Playing social deduction games with reinforcement fine-tuned large language models
items.summary_zh: 强化微调（RFT）越来越多地被用于大语言模型与人类及其他智能体交互的场景。作者用社交推理（隐藏身份）游戏研究 RFT 如何改变 LLM 的社交行为：让经过微调与未微调的 LLM 智能体参与需要隐藏状态推断、社交读心与投票引导的隐藏角色游戏。结果显示，仅直接优化最终胜负结果，LLM 智能体并不能可靠地习得社交推理能力，说明终局胜负提供的奖励信号稀疏且噪声较大。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04261v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used in applications where large language models (LLMs) interact with humans and other agents. Here we use social deduction games to study how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour. We let fine-tuned and base LLM agents play hidden-role games that require hidden-state inference, social reading and vote steering. Our results show that LLM agents do not reliably acquire social-deduction ability by directly optimizing terminal win--loss outcomes, suggesting that final game results provide a sparse and n…
items.why_zh: 它指出仅靠终局胜负的强化微调难以培养 LLM 的社交推理能力，为设计更有效的多智能体训练奖励提供警示。
items.why_en: It shows that outcome-only reinforcement fine-tuning is insufficient for teaching LLMs social reasoning, cautioning against sparse terminal rewards in multi-agent training.

items.title_zh: Harness 修复了什么？关于可见性、基线充分性与评估缺陷的预注册研究
items.title_en: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
items.summary_zh: Harness 搜索会在模型冻结不变的前提下，只要某一改动（提示词、推理开关、token 预算或解析器）能提高分数就保留它。但这类增益可能来自解析器此前读不到的答案、过弱的对照基线，或评估本身的缺陷。作者开展了一项预注册研究，使用三个小模型、三个基准、复现与测试划分、一个 GEPA 搜索分支，并逐一注入六类评估缺陷，完整报告全部 47 个主要端点。结果显示，仅关闭“思考”就能提高准确率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05533v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, reasoning switches, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison, or a defect in the evaluation. We preregistered a study of where these gains come from, with three small models, three benchmarks, replication and test partitions, a GEPA search arm and six evaluation defects injected one at a time, and we report all 47 primary endpoints. Turning thinking off raised accuracy over a cap…
items.why_zh: 它提醒研究者：评测协议分数提升未必来自模型变强，可能只是评估缺陷或基线不足造成的假象。
items.why_en: It warns that harness score gains may reflect evaluation defects or weak baselines rather than genuine model improvement.

items.title_zh: 批模式主动学习中的软策略选择
items.title_en: Soft Strategy Selection for Batch-Mode Active Learning
items.summary_zh: 在真实部署中，主动学习通常要求实践者在尚未标注任何数据前就选定一种采集策略，而策略表现会随数据集、代理模型等设置大幅变化，且不部署就无法评估。现有策略选择方法每一轮只从策略池中探索一个策略，并借助赌博机反馈或模型重训练来确定最优策略，导致大量采集轮次被用于探索策略，而不是采集最有信息量的样本。该工作提出软策略选择方法以缓解这一问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05544v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Real-world deployment of active learning typically forces practitioners to choose an acquisition strategy before any data is labeled. This is a daunting task: strategy performance varies widely across settings (e.g. datasets, surrogate models) and cannot be assessed without deployment. Existing strategy selection methods explore one strategy from a portfolio at each round and identify the optimal one using bandit feedback or model retraining. Many acquisition rounds are therefore spent exploring strategies rather than collecting the most inform…
items.why_zh: 它让主动学习在标注预算有限时把更多轮次用于采集高价值样本，而非低效的策略试错。
items.why_en: It helps active learning spend scarce labeling rounds on informative samples rather than inefficient strategy exploration.

items.title_zh: CLARA：AI 能否评估儿童故事的发展适宜性？
items.title_en: CLARA: Can AI Assess Developmental Appropriateness in Children's Stories?
items.summary_zh: 评估儿童叙事内容是否符合发展阶段，对教育推荐与发展性读写研究都很重要，但这类判断通常依赖主观、难以规模化的人工评估。由此引出一个关键问题：AI 系统能否接近人类对儿童故事的发展性判断？为研究该问题，作者提出 CLARA——一个以认知理论为基础的儿童叙事发展理解框架，通过认知（COG）、语言（LAN）与社会等维度的结构化标注来刻画故事。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05783v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Assessing the developmental suitability of children's narratives is important for educational recommendation and developmental literacy research, yet such assessment typically relies on subjective and difficult-to-scale human judgment. This raises an important question: Can AI systems approximate human developmental judgments of children's stories? To study this problem, we introduce CLARA, a cognitively grounded framework for developmental narrative understanding through structured annotation across cognitive (COG), language (LAN), and social-…
items.why_zh: 它探索用可规模化的 AI 评估替代主观人工判断，为儿童内容推荐与读写发展研究提供新工具。
items.why_en: It explores scalable AI assessment as a substitute for subjective human judgment, offering a new tool for children's content recommendation and literacy research.

items.title_zh: 探究时空视频定位中的查询不敏感行为
items.title_en: Investigating Query-Insensitive Behavior in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
items.summary_zh: 时空视频定位（STVG）的目标是在空间和时间上定位自然语言查询所描述的物体或事件。现有 STVG 模型通常在“每条查询都与输入视频相关”的假设下训练和评测。该工作挑战这一假设，研究当前最先进模型在不相关查询以及缺失文本输入时的行为。实验显示，即使查询与视频内容无关，这些模型仍能给出看似合理的时空预测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06018v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize objects or events described by natural language queries in both space and time. Existing STVG models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that each query is relevant to the input video. In this work, we challenge this assumption by studying the behavior of state-of-the-art STVG models under irrelevant queries and missing textual input. Our experiments show that current models can still produce plausible spatio-temporal predictions even when the query is unrelated to the…
items.why_zh: 它揭示 STVG 模型可能并未真正理解查询，而是依赖视频先验输出看似合理的结果，暴露评测假设的漏洞。
items.why_en: It reveals that STVG models may rely on video priors rather than truly understanding the query, exposing a flaw in standard evaluation assumptions.

items.title_zh: 面向全景街景分割的视觉 Transformer 集成方案
items.title_en: Vision Transformer Ensembles for Panoramic Street Segmentation
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文介绍了在 PalmCity 挑战赛中夺得第一名的分割系统（该成绩对应 2026 年 10 月 5 日的排行榜快照）。研究在近似相等的计算预算下比较了九种预训练分割系统，候选模型包括 DeepLabV3+、SegFormer、UPerNet、Mask2Former、搭配线性解码器的 DINOv3，以及仅编码器的 Mask Transformer。作者指出，街景全景的语义分割能够支撑对城市环境的细致描述，但数据集规模偏小、训练成本不均衡，使得模型选择本身成为难题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06063v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Semantic segmentation of street panoramas can support detailed descriptions of urban environments, yet small datasets and unequal training costs make model selection difficult. This paper presents the system used for a first place submission to the PalmCity challenge in the leaderboard snapshot dated 5 October 2026. Nine pretrained segmentation systems are compared using approximately equal computation budgets. The candidates include DeepLabV3+, SegFormer, UPerNet, Mask2Former, DINOv3 with a linear decoder, and an Encoder only Mask Transformer…
items.why_zh: 为全景街景分割这一城市理解任务提供了在同等算力下做模型选型的可比基准与工程参考。
items.why_en: It offers a comparable, compute-matched benchmark and engineering reference for model selection in panoramic street segmentation.

items.title_zh: 代码正确不等于贡献合格？SWE-CC 评测编码智能体的仓库政策合规性
items.title_en: Correct Code, Broken Contributions? SWE-CC: Benchmarking Repository Policy Compliance for Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 自主编码智能体如今已能解决相当一部分真实 GitHub 问题，但“通过功能测试”与“产出可被合并的高质量贡献”存在本质区别。成熟开源项目会发布仓库专属的贡献政策，涵盖代码风格、git 操作与测试流程，以保证代码质量和长期可维护性。现有基准只用单元测试评估补丁，因此智能体是否遵守仓库治理规则仍属未知。为此作者提出 SWE-CC 基准，用以衡量编码智能体对仓库政策的合规程度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06193v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autonomous coding agents now resolve a substantial share of real-world GitHub issues. However, passing functional tests differs fundamentally from producing a high-quality contribution acceptable for merging. Mature open-source projects publish repository-specific contribution policies, spanning style, git, testing workflows, to ensure code quality and long-term maintainability. Because existing benchmarks evaluate patches solely on unit tests, agent compliance with repository governance remains unknown. In this paper, we introduce SWE-CC, a be…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了当前评测的盲区：合规性可能才是编码智能体真正融入开源协作的关键门槛。
items.why_en: It exposes a blind spot in evaluation: policy compliance may be the real barrier to agents contributing to open-source projects.

items.title_zh: AI 更利于网络攻击者还是防御者？来自未公开漏洞及后续攻击的证据
items.title_en: Does AI Help Cyber Attackers or Defenders? Evidence from Nonpublic Vulnerabilities and Subsequent Attacks
items.summary_zh: 前沿 AI 系统的发布决策越来越依赖网络能力基准，但公开漏洞基准可能让智能体接触到已发布的公告、利用代码与修复方案，从而难以区分“此前见过”与“面对未见漏洞时的真实能力”。研究者因此在五个非公开软件环境中评估开源权重与专有 AI 模型，任务涵盖漏洞利用生成、漏洞修复以及后续攻击，其中包含研究者在漏洞尚未修补期间私下披露的漏洞。这一设计意在更干净地衡量模型的真实攻防能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06584v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The release decision for frontier AI systems increasingly relies on cyber capability benchmarks, yet public vulnerability benchmarks can expose agents to previously published advisories, exploits, and fixes, making it difficult to distinguish prior exposure from capability on unseen vulnerabilities. We evaluate open-weight and proprietary AI models on exploit generation, vulnerability repair and subsequent attacks in five nonpublic software environments, including vulnerabilities we privately disclosed while they remained unpatched. Researcher-…
items.why_zh: 它为更公平地衡量 AI 的真实攻防能力、并支撑前沿模型的发布决策提供了更干净的方法论。
items.why_en: It provides a cleaner methodology for measuring genuine AI cyber capability and informing frontier model release decisions.

items.title_zh: 用大语言模型引导发现权重五的双变量自行车码
items.title_en: Large Language Model-Guided Discovery of Weight-Five Bivariate Bicycle Codes
items.summary_zh: 在早前由大语言模型（LLM）引导的程序演化工作流基础上，研究者转向研究权重五的双变量自行车（BB）码与扰动双变量自行车（PBB）码。其生成的目录包含 1142 个不同的码方案，其中 1081 个是可归因于 LLM 生成程序的非基线方案。目录中认证了连通的 Calderbank–Shor–Steane（CSS）实现 [[96,4,10]]、[[140,6,10]] 与 [[180,4,14]]；搜索后的比较还认证了七个从 Lin–Pryadko 档案导入的构造。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06623v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Building on our earlier program-evolution workflow guided by large language models (LLMs), we study weight-five bivariate bicycle (BB) and perturbed bivariate bicycle (PBB) codes. The resulting catalogue contains 1,142 distinct code proposals, including 1,081 nonbaseline proposals attributable to LLM-generated programs. Across the catalogue, we certify connected Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) realizations [[96,4,10]], [[140,6,10]], and [[180,4,14]]. A post-search comparison certifies seven imported Lin--Pryadko archive constructions. For leadin…
items.why_zh: 它表明 LLM 引导的搜索能自动产出大量量子纠错码候选并给出可验证的构造。
items.why_en: It shows LLM-guided search can mass-produce quantum error-correcting code candidates with certified constructions.

items.title_zh: 基础模型也能推理：只需从训练数据中取一个线索
items.title_en: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
items.summary_zh: 论文研究训练数据如何在基础模型回复起始处的 token 与其后的推理行为之间建立关联。作者首先证明，固定特定的起始 token 线索，就能让基础模型在数学与代码任务上的表现与其经过强化学习（RL）训练的版本相当：例如线索“.\n\nOkay”把 Olmo-3-7B 在 MATH-500 上的 pass@1 准确率从 42% 提升到 78%，而“Alright,”把 Qwen3-14B 的准确率从 72% 提升到 87%。其次，RL 会让这些线索更可能出现，暗示其作用可能与这些训练数据中的关联有关。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06851v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, wh…
items.why_zh: 它提示推理能力或许部分潜藏于训练数据的 token 关联中，促使人们重新审视 RL 提升推理的机制。
items.why_en: It hints that reasoning may partly lie latent in training-data token associations, prompting a rethink of how RL improves reasoning.

items.title_zh: 复杂智能体 AI 系统如何处理通用任务：一项基于轨迹的仿真研究
items.title_en: Characterizing How Complex Agentic AI Systems Handle General Tasks: A Trace-Based Simulation Study
items.summary_zh: 智能体 AI 通过迭代规划、工具使用以及基于观测结果的推理来完成任务，但其系统级行为仍鲜为人知，原因包括执行过程高度非确定性、评估成本高昂，以及对专有模型的可见性有限。论文提出 GAIATrace，这是首个针对两个最先进智能体系统（MiroThinker 与 OWL）运行 GAIA 基准的 token 级轨迹数据集；GAIA 由异构任务构成，便于考察复杂数据集与智能体架构下的行为。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.01725v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Agentic AI completes tasks through iterative planning, tool use, and reasoning based on observed outcomes. Despite its popularity, its system-level behavior remains poorly understood, particularly for complex datasets and agent architectures-owing to highly non-deterministic execution, prohibitive evaluation costs, and limited visibility into proprietary models. This paper presents GAIATrace, the first token-level trace dataset of two state-of-the-art agentic systems (MiroThinker and OWL) running GAIA, a benchmark composed of a heterogeneous…
items.why_zh: 首个 token 级轨迹数据集为理解智能体系统的运行机制与失败模式提供了可观测依据。
items.why_en: The first token-level trace dataset gives observable evidence for understanding how agentic systems work and fail.

items.title_zh: 先看再动：动态 3D 故事世界中的叙事驱动世界视觉注意力
items.title_en: Look-Before-Move: Narrative-Grounded World Visual Attention in Dynamic 3D Story Worlds
items.summary_zh: 随着具身 AI 与世界模型越来越多地在动态 3D 环境中运行，视觉感知必须超越被动解读给定观测，转而主动决定该观察什么。论文通过动态 3D 故事世界中的相机规划来研究这一问题：相机不仅要生成平滑运动，还要在移动之前判断应该获取哪些视觉证据。作者把这种能力表述为“叙事驱动的世界视觉注意力”，即相机作为一个具身观察者，自行决定要看什么。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.26964v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As embodied AI and world models increasingly operate in dynamic 3D environments, visual perception must move beyond passively interpreting given observations toward actively deciding what to observe. We study this problem through camera planning in dynamic 3D story worlds, where the camera must not only generate smooth motion, but also decide what visual evidence should be acquired before it moves. We formulate this capability as Narrative-Grounded World Visual Attention, where the camera acts as an embodied observer that determines what to o…
items.why_zh: 它把“该观察什么”本身变成学习目标，为具身智能体的主动感知提供了新范式。
items.why_en: It turns 'what to observe' into a learning objective, offering a new paradigm for active perception in embodied agents.

items.title_zh: 面向自监督强化学习的 1000 层网络：加深网络可解锁新的目标到达能力
items.title_en: 1000 Layer Networks for Self-Supervised RL: Scaling Depth Can Enable New Goal-Reaching Capabilities
items.summary_zh: 自监督学习的大规模扩展曾推动语言与视觉领域取得突破，但强化学习（RL）至今未出现可比进展。论文研究能够释放显著可扩展性提升的自监督 RL 构建模块，其中网络深度是关键因素。与近年来多数 RL 论文依赖的浅层架构（约 2–5 层）不同，作者通过实验证明，把深度增加到最多 1024 层可以显著提升性能，并带来新的目标到达能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2503.14858v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Scaling up self-supervised learning has driven breakthroughs in language and vision, yet comparable progress has remained elusive in reinforcement learning (RL). In this paper, we study building blocks for self-supervised RL that unlock substantial improvements in scalability, with network depth serving as a critical factor. Whereas most RL papers in recent years have relied on shallow architectures (around 2 - 5 layers), we demonstrate that increasing the depth up to 1024 layers can significantly boost performance. Our experiments are…
items.why_zh: 它挑战了 RL 长期依赖浅层网络的惯例，表明深度扩展是自监督强化学习尚未充分挖掘的新杠杆。
items.why_en: It challenges RL's reliance on shallow networks, showing depth scaling is an underexploited lever for self-supervised RL.

items.title_zh: 莱比锡基准：100 道研究级数学题评测大模型
items.title_en: Benchmarks in Leipzig
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 4 月 1 日至 5 月 15 日期间，49 位数学家共同整理出一套带有已知答案的研究级数学问题数据集，其中大部分工作完成于德国莱比锡马克斯·普朗克数学科学研究所举办的三天工作坊，共有 35 名参与者。论文正式发布了这套包含 100 道题目的合集。作者对这些题目进行了分三阶段的评测：先由五个最先进的大语言模型及其前代版本各作答一次，随后进行每个模型 20 次运行的重复评测（原文后续内容被截断）。该工作为衡量 LLM 在高等数学推理上的真实水平提供了新的基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.05818v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Between April 1 and May 15, 2026, a group of 49 mathematicians compiled a dataset of research-level mathematics questions with known answers. Most of the work was done during the three-day workshop Benchmarks in Leipzig with 35 participants at the Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in the Sciences in Leipzig, Germany. We present the resulting collection of 100~questions. We evaluated these questions in three stages: a single attempt by five state-of-the-art LLMs and their predecessors, followed by a 20-runs-per-model evaluation with t…
items.why_zh: 研究级数学题目难度高、答案明确，能更严格地检验大模型的高阶推理能力，而非套用记忆。
items.why_en: Research-level math problems with known answers offer a rigorous test of LLMs' higher-order reasoning rather than memorization.

items.title_zh: 联邦多模态大模型微调：弹性正则化与合成回放应对灾难性遗忘
items.title_en: Continual Learning with Elastic Regularization and Synthetic Replay for Federated MLLM Fine-Tuning
items.summary_zh: 在分布式网络上对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）进行联邦微调，可以让模型在隐私敏感场景下适配不断变化的数据流，但动态环境中的稳健部署面临一个根本障碍：灾难性遗忘——按顺序进行的任务更新会抹去此前在视觉、语言和跨模态表征中学到的知识。论文指出，这一问题对运行在安全敏感领域的自主联网 AI 尤为关键，例如内容审核等场景。作者提出结合弹性正则化与合成回放的持续学习方法，以在联邦微调过程中缓解遗忘。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.12112v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Federated fine-tuning of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) across distributed networks enables privacy-sensitive adaptation to evolving data streams, yet a fundamental obstacle prevents robust deployment in dynamic environments: catastrophic forgetting, wherein sequential task updates erase previously acquired knowledge across visual, linguistic, and cross-modal representations. Addressing this challenge is especially critical for autonomous networked AI operating in safety-sensitive domains, such as content moderation, where rel…
items.why_zh: 灾难性遗忘是联邦持续学习落地的核心瓶颈，直接影响内容审核等安全敏感场景中的模型可靠性。
items.why_en: Catastrophic forgetting is a core obstacle to deploying federated continual learning, directly affecting model reliability in safety-sensitive uses like content moderation.

items.title_zh: 语言模型时代的 AI 问责生态
items.title_en: The AI Accountability Ecosystem in the Era of Language Models
items.summary_zh: 本文基于“问责生态”框架，对 AI 问责机制进行回顾与更新，以回应大语言模型面向公众开放以来的最新发展。作者提出三项相互关联的更新：一是将问责生态重新定位于 AI 基础设施与供应链；二是更加强调结果监测，以及对支持去中心化系统改进的问题识别；三是第三项更新（原文摘要在此处被截断）。整体上，文章旨在让原有的问责框架适应生成式 AI 大规模部署后的新格局。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12320v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This article reviews and updates the framework for accountability in AI based on account- ability ecosystems. We update the framework in light of the latest developments since the release of Large Language Models for general public use. We propose three interlinked updates to the original AI accountability ecosystem: (i) reorienting the accountability ecosystem to AI infrastructure and supply chains, (ii) providing greater emphasis on outcomes monitoring and identification of issues that support decentralized system improvement, and (ii…
items.why_zh: 生成式 AI 已深度嵌入基础设施与供应链，问责机制必须随之调整才能真正落地。
items.why_en: As generative AI becomes embedded in infrastructure and supply chains, accountability mechanisms must adapt to remain effective.

items.title_zh: 微调会撤销激活引导吗？行为恢复但权重编辑未被逆转
items.title_en: Does Fine-Tuning Undo Activation Steering? Behavioural Recovery Without Weight-Edit Reversal
items.summary_zh: 激活引导可以直接嵌入语言模型的权重中，在不做推理时干预的情况下塑造模型行为，为发布前编码对齐属性提供了一条途径。然而模型在部署后经常会被继续微调，这种嵌入式干预能否存续此前并不清楚。作者在五个指令微调模型（3B 至 14B）上，研究了针对“拒绝消融”和“简洁性增强”的嵌入式引导，在非对抗性的 SFT 与 RLHF 下的稳定性。结果显示，优化越强，引导退化越明显；行为虽会恢复，但权重层面的编辑并未被真正逆转。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.24988v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Activation steering can be embedded directly into a language model's weights, shaping behaviour without inference-time intervention and offering a way to encode alignment prior to release. However, models are routinely fine-tuned after deployment, and it is unknown whether embedded interventions survive this. We study the stability of embedded steering for refusal ablation and brevity amplification across five instruction-tuned models (3B-14B) under non-adversarial SFT and RLHF. We find that steering degrades more under stronger optimis…
items.why_zh: 若发布前嵌入的对齐干预会被后续微调减弱，那么“发布即安全”的假设就需要重新评估。
items.why_en: If alignment interventions embedded before release weaken under later fine-tuning, the assumption that release-time safety persists must be reconsidered.

items.title_zh: 概念与组块的统一解释
items.title_en: A Unified Account of Concepts and Chunks
items.summary_zh: 认知心理学分别研究人们如何编码、使用和学习描述类别的概念，以及如何表征、识别和习得熟悉元素模式的组块（chunk），但这两条文献脉络几乎互不相干，给统一的认知理论带来挑战。本文首先回顾 Cobweb——一种关于分类与概念形成的计算模型，随后提出一个纳入组块及其习得过程的扩展理论。作者指出，该理论不对模态作出承诺，因而具有较广的适用性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30414v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Cognitive psychology has studied how people encode, use, and learn concepts that describe categories, and how they represent, recognize, and acquire chunks for familiar patterns of elements. The literatures on these two topics are nearly disjoint, which poses a challenge for unified theories of cognition. In this paper, we review Cobweb, a computational account of categorization and concept formation, then propose an extended theory that incorporates chunks and their acquisition. The theory makes no commitments about modality, applying…
items.why_zh: 把概念与组块纳入同一计算框架，有助于弥合认知科学中长期割裂的两条研究传统。
items.why_en: Bringing concepts and chunks into one computational framework helps bridge two long-separated research traditions in cognitive science.

items.title_zh: 建筑热负荷短期预测混合模型的比较综述
items.title_en: Comparative review of hybrid forecasting models for short-term prediction of building thermal load
items.summary_zh: 本文对用于建筑热需求短期预测的多种混合模型进行了比较综述，重点评估将数据驱动模型与其他先进技术相结合的方案。作者首先梳理了文献中已有的技术，并得出结论：常见做法是用元启发式算法或另一个数据驱动模型来辨识基础模型的参数。定性评估涵盖各方法的输入与输出特征、主要优势等内容，为建筑热负荷预测的模型选型提供参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06881v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, a comparative review of different hybrid models for short-term forecasting of building thermal demand is carried out. Particularly, the assessment tackles the comparison of data-driven models enhanced with other state-of-the-art techniques. At the first step, the existing techniques reported in the literature are analysed. It is concluded that Metaheuristics or a data-driven model are used to identify the parameters of the basic model. The qualitative evaluation includes for each method the input and output features, main advantage…
items.why_zh: 建筑热负荷的准确短期预测是建筑节能与需求侧管理的关键技术基础。
items.why_en: Accurate short-term building thermal load forecasting is a key technical basis for energy efficiency and demand-side management.

items.title_zh: 提示级差分隐私下的奖励驱动学习
items.title_en: Reward-Driven Learning under Prompt-Level Differential Privacy
items.summary_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）会在可能属于机密的问题上训练语言模型，而训练后的模型可能泄露它见过哪些问题。本文研究提示级差分隐私下的 RLVR：发布出去的权重必须对任一训练问题是否出现在数据集中满足 (ε,δ)-差分隐私。作者把一个提示对应的全部回答视为一条隐私记录，方法是对这些回答的梯度进行聚合、对该提示的贡献只裁剪一次、加入高斯噪声，并进行隐私组合。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07212v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model on problems that may themselves be confidential, and the trained model can reveal which problems it saw. We study RLVR under prompt-level differential privacy: the released weights must be ({\epsilon},{\delta})-differentially private with respect to the presence of any one training problem. Taking the group of responses to one prompt as the privacy record, our method aggregates their gradients, clips the prompt's contribution once, adds Gaussian noise, and composes the…
items.why_zh: 它把差分隐私保证引入 RLVR，使模型在训练机密数据时不必以泄露训练集为代价。
items.why_en: It brings differential privacy guarantees to RLVR, letting models train on confidential data without leaking the training set.

items.title_zh: 数据、数字与几何：数值方法、机器学习与评估三讲教程
items.title_en: Data, Numbers, and Geometry: Three Tutorials on Numerical Methods, Machine Learning, and Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了为 2026 年 4 月在班夫国际研究站举办的“DANGER：数据、数字与几何”工作坊开发的三份实用教程，主题是面向数学研究的数值计算与机器学习。第一份教程从微分形式的逐点求值出发构建外微积分的数值方法，采用外导数的通量表述，并用欧几里得空间与球面上的例子说明几何恒等式、拓扑特征以及近似与有限精度带来的影响（原文后续内容被截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present three practical tutorials on numerical computation and machine learning for mathematical research, developed for the DANGER: Data, Numbers, and Geometry workshop held at the Banff International Research Station in April 2026. The first develops a numerical approach to exterior calculus from pointwise evaluations of differential forms, using a flux formulation of the exterior derivative. Examples in Euclidean space and on the sphere illustrate geometric identities, topological features, and the effects of approximation and finite precis…
items.why_zh: 它把数值方法与机器学习工具系统地引入数学研究实践，降低了相关技术的使用门槛。
items.why_en: It systematically brings numerical methods and machine learning tools into mathematical research practice, lowering the barrier to using them.

items.title_zh: 用表格基础模型评估主动特征获取策略
items.title_en: Evaluation of Active Feature Acquisition Policies with Tabular Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 主动特征获取研究的是如何按顺序采集特征，以最大化关于目标变量的信息。作者探讨如何利用先验数据拟合网络（PFN）这类无需任务特定训练的现成模型，从有限的离线数据中学习和评估此类策略。研究发现，在离线数据覆盖不均衡的情况下，以总预测熵作为奖励会引入一种认知偏差，导致策略惩罚对稀疏观测特征的采集。该偏差会影响策略的学习与评估结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Active feature acquisition learns policies that sequentially acquire features to maximize information about a target variable. We study how to learn and evaluate such policies from finite offline data using prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which are off-the-shelf models that output posterior predictive distributions without task-specific training. We show that under the imbalanced coverage of offline data, using total predictive entropy as a reward creates an epistemic bias that penalizes acquiring sparsely observed features. Specifically, this…
items.why_zh: 揭示了离线数据覆盖不均衡时熵奖励设计的系统性偏差，为主动特征获取的奖励与评估设计提供警示。
items.why_en: It exposes a systematic epistemic bias in entropy-based reward design under imbalanced offline coverage, warning against naive evaluation of active feature acquisition.

items.title_zh: 主动特征获取实现低成本时序预测并减轻受试者负担
items.title_en: Active Feature Acquisition for Cost-Efficient Temporal Prediction with Reduced Participant Burden
items.summary_zh: 心理病理结果的准确预测是心理学的核心问题，研究者常为此采集密集纵向数据。然而，为提升预测精度而采集大量变量，往往与降低受试者负担的需求相冲突：每次采集更多变量可能提高预测效果，但过多的采集会增加无应答与流失风险。纵向主动特征获取（LAFA）被提出作为一种原则性方法，在预测精度与参与者负担之间进行权衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate forecasting of pathological outcomes is a central problem in psychology. To do so, psychologists often collect intensive longitudinal data. However, in such studies, the desire to acquire a large number of variables for the sake of accurate prediction is often counteracted by the need to minimize participant burden. Acquiring more variables per occasion can yield better predictions, but having too many acquisitions increase the risk of non-response and attrition. Longitudinal Active Feature Acquisition (LAFA) is a principled approach to…
items.why_zh: 为长期追踪研究提供了在预测精度与参与者负担之间权衡的方法框架。
items.why_en: It offers a principled framework for trading off predictive accuracy against participant burden in intensive longitudinal studies.

items.title_zh: 用自适应获取与序贯融合实现高效多模态推理
items.title_en: Efficient Multimodal Inference through Adaptive Acquisition and Sequential Fusion
items.summary_zh: 多模态系统通常会对所有可用输入进行编码，即使其中一部分已足以完成预测。自适应获取可以利用逐步融合的证据来预测结果，并据此决定下一个要编码的模态以及何时停止，从而降低成本。但序贯融合使预测依赖顺序，基于这些预测的决策可能需要区分同一已获取集合的多种排列历史。为此，作者提出 SemARC，将序贯模态聚合器（SeMA）与自适应运行时控制器（ARC）耦合起来。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal systems often encode every available input, even when a subset suffices for prediction. Adaptive acquisition can reduce this cost by using predictions from incrementally fused evidence to decide which modality to encode next and when to stop. However, sequential fusion makes these predictions order-dependent, so decisions based on them may need to distinguish factorially many histories of the same acquired set. We introduce SemARC, which couples a Sequential Modality Aggregator (SeMA) with an Adaptive Runtime Controller (ARC) and uses…
items.why_zh: 在尽量保持预测能力的同时降低多模态推理的编码与计算成本。
items.why_en: It reduces the encoding and compute cost of multimodal inference while aiming to preserve predictive performance.

items.title_zh: 结构而非信念：组合半臂老虎机中用 LLM 导出协方差做相关 Thompson 采样
items.title_en: Structure, Not Belief: Correlated Thompson Sampling from LLM-Derived Covariance in Combinatorial Semi-Bandits
items.summary_zh: 组合 Thompson 采样（CTS）为每个臂独立抽取后验样本，因此其探索动态忽略了臂与臂之间的关系。作者研究对这一动态的最小改动：向 LLM 查询一次臂的划分，再通过基于簇排名的 RBF 核把该划分转化为正定相关矩阵 Σ。此后每轮的后验样本以 Σ 为协方差抽取，而 Beta 后验仅由真实奖励更新——也就是说，LLM 影响的是采样器如何移动，而非它相信什么。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07470v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Combinatorial Thompson sampling (CTS) draws independent posterior samples for every arm, so its exploration dynamics ignore any relation among arms. We study a minimal change to those dynamics: an LLM is queried once for a partition of the arms, the partition becomes a positive-definite correlation matrix $\Sigma$ through an RBF kernel on cluster ranks, and the per-round posterior sample is drawn with covariance $\Sigma$ while the Beta posteriors are updated from real rewards only, so the LLM shapes how the sampler moves, not what it believes. We…
items.why_zh: 表明 LLM 可以只提供结构先验来改善组合探索，而不干扰对奖励的信念。
items.why_en: It shows an LLM can supply purely structural priors to improve combinatorial exploration without distorting reward beliefs.

items.title_zh: SpecBraM：EEG 基础模型该预测什么？掩码频带功率预测与波形重建之比较
items.title_en: SpecBraM: What Should an EEG Foundation Model Predict? Masked Band-Power Prediction versus Waveform Reconstruction
items.summary_zh: 自监督 EEG 模型通常重建被掩码的波形或预测离散码本。本文研究一种更贴合任务的替代目标：掩码频带功率预测（MBP），即对被掩码的通道-时间块预测固定的窄带对数谱能量。该目标保留了与睡眠分期相关的节律功率，同时避免了对相位敏感的波形重建和学习码本。作者在三个预训练随机种子下，用匹配的骨干网络、预训练数据（2388 小时）和训练步数，比较频带功率与波形两类目标。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-supervised EEG models often reconstruct masked waveforms or predict discrete codes. We study a task-aligned alternative: masked band-power prediction (MBP), which predicts fixed narrow-band log spectral energy for masked channel-time patches. This target retains rhythm power relevant to sleep staging while avoiding phase-sensitive waveform reconstruction and a learned codebook. Across three pretraining seeds, we compare band-power and waveform targets with matched backbones, pretraining data (2,388 hours), and training steps, including a 2x2…
items.why_zh: 指出 EEG 自监督预训练目标应贴合下游任务，频带功率预测可能是优于波形重建的选择。
items.why_en: It argues that EEG self-supervised pretraining objectives should be task-aligned, with band-power prediction potentially outperforming waveform reconstruction.

items.title_zh: AFA-BANDIT：预算约束下可证近最优的在线多特征分类
items.title_en: AFA-BANDIT: Provably Near-Optimal Online Multi-Feature Classification Under Budget Constraints
items.summary_zh: 主动特征获取（AFA）是一类分类问题：智能体在预测每个样本的标签前，需决定获取哪些有成本的特征。与在完全观测数据上离线训练固定策略与分类器的批量 AFA 不同，在线 AFA 会随样本到来利用已揭示的标签更新预测器。现有在线方法要么使用缺乏性能保证的深度强化学习，要么最大化成本调整后的奖励而不强制全局预算。本文把在线 AFA 建模为带背包约束的组合老虎机问题，提出 AFA-BANDIT 并给出近最优性保证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) is a classification problem in which an agent decides which costly features to acquire before predicting each sample's label. Unlike batch AFA, which trains a fixed policy and classifier offline on fully observed data, online AFA updates its predictor from revealed labels as samples arrive. Existing online methods either use deep reinforcement learning (RL) without performance guarantees or maximize cost-adjusted reward rather than enforce a global budget. We formulate online AFA as a combinatorial Bandits with Kn…
items.why_zh: 在强制全局预算的前提下，为在线特征获取首次提供可证明的近最优性保证。
items.why_en: It provides provably near-optimal guarantees for online feature acquisition under an enforced global budget.

items.title_zh: 自适应模型反演攻击放大隐私-鲁棒性权衡
items.title_en: Adaptive Model Inversion Attacks Generalize a Privacy-Robustness Tradeoff
items.summary_zh: 论文表明，高分辨率模型反演攻击（MIA）的常规评估显著低估了训练数据的隐私泄露。在攻击做出简单自适应改动后，最先进的隐私防御、MixUp 与对抗训练等标准训练技术以及无防御模型，在 FaceScrub 数据集上的训练图像泄露率都高出 1.16 至 6.59 倍，其中自称隐私保护最强的防御增幅最大。作者还指出，测得的泄露量取决于所用特征基。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07677v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we show that standard evaluations of high-resolution Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) significantly underestimate training-data privacy leakage. State-of-the-art privacy defenses, standard training techniques such as MixUp and Adversarial Training, and undefended models all leak training images at rates 1.16 to 6.59 times higher on FaceScrub under simple adaptive changes to the attack, with the largest increases among defenses reporting the strongest privacy. We further show that measured leakage depends on the feature basis of the e…
items.why_zh: 提醒隐私防御的现有评估可能被低估，需要针对自适应攻击重新衡量泄露风险。
items.why_en: It warns that current privacy-defense evaluations may underestimate leakage and must be re-tested against adaptive attacks.

items.title_zh: 对抗训练的线性 Transformer 是高斯混合模型下最优的鲁棒上下文学习器
items.title_en: Adversarially Trained Linear Transformers Are Optimal Robust In-Context Learners for Gaussian Mixtures
items.summary_zh: 对抗训练是最可靠的对抗攻击防御手段之一，但其高昂的计算成本通常需要为每个任务重新付出。稳健基础模型提供了另一种思路：一次性完成对抗预训练，再通过轻量适配把鲁棒性迁移到下游任务。然而一个根本问题仍待解答：预训练阶段获得的鲁棒性能否无需额外对抗训练就迁移到未见任务？本文给出了肯定回答，表明单个模型即可实现这一目标。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07754v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adversarial training is one of the most reliable defenses against adversarial attacks, but its high computational cost must generally be paid anew for each task. Robust foundation models offer a promising alternative: adversarially pretrain a model once and then transfer its robustness to downstream tasks through lightweight adaptation. However, a fundamental question remains open: can robustness acquired during pretraining transfer to unseen tasks without further adversarial training? In this study, we answer this question affirmatively. A singl…
items.why_zh: 为“一次对抗预训练、多处鲁棒迁移”提供了理论依据，可降低获取鲁棒性的重复成本。
items.why_en: It gives theoretical evidence that one-time adversarial pretraining can transfer robustness, reducing the repeated cost of obtaining it.

items.title_zh: bf16 转换之失：导出三值语言模型可能回退大部分低学习率代码改动
items.title_en: Lost in the bf16 Cast: Exporting Ternary Language Models Can Revert Most Low-Learning-Rate Code Changes
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文审计了三家实验室的三值（ternary）语言模型导出流程，覆盖 BitNet b1.58、Falcon-E 与 BitCPM。这类模型以较高精度的潜权重（latent weights）进行微调，部署时再通过导出步骤转成三值编码，而官方文档中的流程会先把潜权重转换为 bf16。作者发现，在已发布的检查点中，对发布潜权重做 fp32 量化所得的编码与部署编码并不一致：Falcon-E 和 BitCPM 有 0.83%–1.77% 的编码不同，BitNet 2B-4T 则为 1.530%。这些分歧大多出现在 bf16 舍入会改变乘积结果的编码上，论文标题因此指出该转换可能“回退”大部分低学习率下产生的代码改动。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ternary language models such as BitNet b1.58, Falcon-E and BitCPM are fine-tuned with higher-precision latent weights and deployed as ternary codes produced by an export step that, in the labs' documented pipelines, first casts the latents to bf16. We audit those pipelines across three labs. In released checkpoints, fp32 quantization of the shipped latents disagrees with the deployed codes on 0.83-1.77% of codes in Falcon-E and BitCPM and on 1.530% in BitNet 2B-4T; for Falcon-E and BitCPM most disagreements are products that bf16 rounding lands e…
items.why_zh: 暴露三值模型部署管线中一个隐蔽的精度转换环节，可能悄悄抹掉微调成果、影响模型压缩与发布的可复现性。
items.why_en: It exposes a subtle precision cast in ternary-model deployment that can silently erase fine-tuning gains and undermine reproducibility of released compressed models.

items.title_zh: 攀登设计阶梯：面向早期电路时序预测的序贯知识蒸馏
items.title_en: Climbing the Design Ladder: Sequential Knowledge Distillation for Early-Stage Circuit Timing Prediction
items.summary_zh: 集成电路设计要经过逻辑综合、布局规划、布局与布线等多个阶段，每个阶段耗时从数小时到数周不等。若时序违例到流程后期才被发现，就必须回退到早期阶段重新迭代，既浪费算力又推迟产品上市。虽然用早期阶段数据预测布线后时序有望避免这类失败，但现有机器学习方法难以跨越综合后逻辑描述与布线后结果之间的巨大抽象鸿沟。论文提出“设计阶梯”式的序贯知识蒸馏方法，逐级弥合阶段间的表示差距，以提升早期时序预测的可用性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.08457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integrated circuit design involves multiple design stages: logic synthesis, floorplanning, placement, and routing, with each stage taking hours to weeks to complete. Discovering timing violations late in this flow forces costly iterations back to earlier stages, wasting computational resources and delaying product launches. While predicting post-routing timing from early-stage data could prevent these failures, existing machine learning approaches struggle with the massive abstraction gap between post-synthesis logical descriptions and post-routi…
items.why_zh: 若能可靠预测布线后时序，就能在设计早期发现违例，节省大量迭代算力并加快芯片上市。
items.why_en: Reliable post-routing timing prediction would catch violations early, saving costly design iterations and accelerating chip delivery.

items.title_zh: 学习如何决定遗忘：记忆—泛化谱系上的去学习研究
items.title_en: How Learning Governs Unlearning across the Memorization-Generalization Spectrum
items.summary_zh: 去学习（unlearning）旨在消除模型在学习阶段获得的不良能力，但少有研究考察“模型如何学”会怎样影响其后续“如何忘”。论文从记忆与泛化这两种最具代表性又相互竞争的训练策略出发研究该关联：作者先利用模块加法任务中的 grokking 现象区分出偏记忆型与偏泛化型模型，再比较它们对去学习的响应，发现偏泛化型模型出现更严重的保留（retention）问题。该工作把学习机制与去学习效果联系起来，提示去学习方法的评估需要考虑模型此前的学习方式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.08577v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While unlearning seeks to negate undesired capabilities acquired through learning, little research has examined how the way models learn shapes their subsequent unlearning. In this paper, we investigate this connection from the perspectives of memorization and generalization, the two most representative yet competing strategies that models employ during training. We first classify memorization- and generalization-heavy models using grokking in modular addition and compare their responses to unlearning, showing that the latter suffer greater retai…
items.why_zh: 它揭示去学习效果取决于模型此前的学习方式，为设计和评估机器遗忘方法提供了新的分析视角。
items.why_en: It shows that unlearning effectiveness depends on how a model originally learned, offering a new lens for designing and evaluating machine-unlearning methods.

items.title_zh: 随机特征高斯过程注意力：带校准不确定性的线性时间概率注意力
items.title_en: Random Feature Gaussian Process Attention: Linear-Time Probabilistic Attention with Calibrated Uncertainty
items.summary_zh: Transformer 是当前最强的建模框架之一，但校准不佳限制了它在安全攸关场景中的可靠性。一种有前景的思路是把注意力解释为高斯过程（GP）后验，从而获得有原则的不确定性校准，然而核矩阵求逆带来随序列长度三次方增长的复杂度；此后的解耦式 GP 变体虽把开销降到二次，实际中依然过于昂贵。论文提出一种即插即用的随机傅里叶特征方法，使这种概率化注意力达到线性时间，在保留校准不确定性的同时大幅降低计算成本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.08578v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transformers provide a state-of-the-art modeling framework, yet poor calibration limits their reliability in safety-critical applications. A promising direction addresses this issue by interpreting attention as a Gaussian process (GP) posterior, which enables principled uncertainty calibration but incurs cubic complexity in sequence length due to the inversion of the kernel; although decoupled GP variants reduced the cost to quadratic, the computation remains prohibitive in practice. In this paper, we propose the plug-and-play random Fourier feat…
items.why_zh: 在保持不确定性校准的同时把概率注意力降到线性复杂度，有望推动 Transformer 在安全攸关场景中的可靠部署。
items.why_en: Making probabilistic attention linear-time while keeping calibrated uncertainty could enable more reliable Transformers in safety-critical applications.

items.title_zh: 基于合效应建模的方差最优离策略评估
items.title_en: Variance-Optimal Off-Policy Evaluation with Conjunct Effect Modeling
items.summary_zh: 上下文赌博机策略的离策略评估（OPE）常因动作级重要性权重而方差过大。双稳健（DR）估计在共同支撑假设下保持无偏，却仍要承受这些高方差的动作级权重；此前的合效应模型估计器 OffCEM 用更稳定的簇级权重替代它们，代价是依赖奖励模型的局部正确性。论文在 DR 与 OffCEM 所需的假设下进一步分析这一权衡，指出存在方差最优的估计方式，为在两类方法之间取得更低方差的离策略评估提供了理论依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.08677v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) for contextual bandit policies becomes challenging when action-level importance weighting incurs excessive variance. Doubly robust (DR) estimation remains unbiased under common support but retains these high-variance action-level weights. A prior estimator, Off-policy evaluation with Conjunct Effect Model (OffCEM), replaces them with more stable cluster-level weights, at the cost of relying on local correctness of the reward model. In this paper, we show that, under the assumptions required by DR and OffCEM, there exis…
items.why_zh: 为高方差场景下的离策略评估提供更稳健的估计思路，有助于更可靠地评估推荐与决策策略。
items.why_en: It offers a more stable way to evaluate policies offline, improving reliability for recommendation and decision-making systems.

items.title_zh: 小语言模型抽象推理任务的系统性研究
items.title_en: A Systematic Study of Small Language Models on Abstract Reasoning Tasks
items.summary_zh: 抽象推理基准上的终点准确率并不能说明语言模型学到的是可迁移的规则，还是仅仅拟合了特定分布中的规律。论文在 ARC-TGI 基准上研究小语言模型的这一区别：该基准把抽象网格变换组织成可控的任务族，并支持重采样、空间平移与跨基准迁移。作者在监督微调下对 decoder-only、编码器—解码器以及混合专家（MoE）三类模型家族进行了超过 1000 次运行的剖析，系统考察其表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.08680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Endpoint accuracy on abstract-reasoning benchmarks does not reveal whether a language model has acquired a transferable rule or fit distribution-specific regularities. We study this distinction in small language models on the ARC-TGI benchmark, which organizes abstract grid transformations into controllable task families and supports resampling, spatial shifts, and cross-benchmark transfer. Across more than 1,000 runs, we profile decoder-only, encoder--decoder, and mixture-of-experts model families under supervised fine-tuning. We examine the eff…
items.why_zh: 区分“学到规则”与“拟合分布”对判断小模型的真实推理能力至关重要，为基准评测提供了更细致的证据。
items.why_en: Distinguishing rule learning from distribution fitting is crucial for judging small models' true reasoning ability and for interpreting benchmark scores.

items.title_zh: 四旋翼飞行控制中的统计湍流与高保真扰动场
items.title_en: Statistical Turbulence and High-Fidelity Disturbance Fields for Quadrotor Flight Control
items.summary_zh: 强化学习四旋翼控制器通常在简化的风场模型下训练，但风场保真度（而非风速大小）对策略鲁棒性的影响一直缺乏量化。论文比较了五种扰动保真度：无风飞行、离散 1-cosine 阵风、统计湍流、合成相干结构，以及大气边界层的大涡模拟（LES）场，并用近端策略优化（PPO）智能体做完整的跨保真度训练—测试评估，同时以级联 PID 作为对照。该研究系统检验了训练风场与实际扰动的失配如何影响控制策略的鲁棒性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06874v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement-learning quadrotor controllers are usually trained under simplified wind models, yet the impact of wind-field fidelity, as opposed to magnitude, on policy robustness remains unquantified. This paper compares five disturbance-fidelity levels, from wind-free flight and discrete 1-cosine gusts through statistical turbulence and synthetic coherent structures to large-eddy-simulation fields of the atmospheric boundary layer, in a full cross-fidelity train test evaluation of proximal policy optimization (PPO) agents, with cascaded PID a…
items.why_zh: 量化训练风场保真度与真实扰动的差距，为无人机控制在真实大气环境中的鲁棒性评估提供依据。
items.why_en: Quantifying how training wind fidelity differs from real disturbances informs how robust drone controllers can be in real atmospheric conditions.

items.title_zh: 40 亿参数开放模型回答随机试验问题：一次注册测试与许可干净的发布
items.title_en: Calibrated Answers About Randomized Trials From a 4-Billion-Parameter Open Model: A Registered Test and a License-Clean Release
items.summary_zh: Fiorillo v0.5 是一个开放模型，针对带类型的问题给出每个答案的概率。其主力专用模型读取被截断到 6144 token 的随机试验论文，判断某项干预相较对照是显著增加、显著减少还是未显著改变某结局指标（基于 Evidence Inference 2.0，简称 EI）。该模型以 Qwen3-4B-Base 为底座，加入低秩适配器与一个决策头，并且仅在 2657 篇训练文献中许可允许复用的 1431 篇上针对 EI 微调。研究在 Open Science 框架下注册了四项评价标准，并同步发布了许可干净的版本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07019v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fiorillo v0.5 is an open model that answers typed questions with a probability for each answer. Its main specialist reads a randomized trial's article, cut to 6,144 tokens, and answers whether an intervention significantly increased, significantly decreased or did not significantly change an outcome against a comparator (Evidence Inference 2.0, EI). It is Qwen3-4B-Base with low-rank adapters and a decision head, fine-tuned for EI only on the 1,431 of 2,657 training articles whose own license allows reuse. Four criteria registered on the Open Sc…
items.why_zh: 它展示了在严格许可约束下构建医学证据判定模型并进行预注册评测的可行路径，兼顾开放性与可校准性。
items.why_en: It demonstrates a license-clean, preregistered path to building a probability-calibrated model for medical evidence assessment.

items.title_zh: 为世界模型中的鲁棒决策建模潜在扰动
items.title_en: Modeling Latent Disturbances for Robust Decision-Making in World Models
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇 arXiv 论文（cross 类），研究在世界模型（WM）的潜在空间中进行鲁棒决策。鲁棒优化通常要求给定明确的动力学和具有物理意义的扰动，使机器人即便在最坏扰动下也能选出有效动作。但把这套原则搬到世界模型学到的潜在空间时，出现了根本性难题：世界模型的状态空间与动力学完全是从高维观测中学习推断出来的，因此如何定义潜在空间中的扰动并不清楚。论文针对这一问题展开探讨。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07599v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we study robust decision-making in the latent space of world models (WMs). Robust optimization is a mathematical framework where, given explicitly specified dynamics and physically meaningful disturbances, a robot can select actions that remain effective even under worst-case disturbances. However, applying this principle to the learned latent space of WMs introduces a fundamental challenge: because WMs have fully learned state spaces and dynamics inferred from high-dimensional observations, it is unclear how to define latent-spa…
items.why_zh: 世界模型被广泛用于机器人规划，如何在其学得的潜在空间里给出可靠的鲁棒性保证，是落地应用的关键难题。
items.why_en: World models are widely used for robot planning, so defining reliable robustness guarantees in their learned latent spaces is key to deployment.

items.title_zh: 贝叶斯优化中的直接遗憾最小化
items.title_en: Direct Regret Optimization in Bayesian Optimization
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇 arXiv 论文（replace 类），提出一种新的“直接遗憾优化”方法用于贝叶斯优化（BO）。传统 BO 通常分别手工设计采集函数和代理模型，并且往往只做短视（myopic）决策。该工作则从一组候选模型与采集函数中蒸馏知识，联合学习最优模型与非短视采集函数，并显式地以最小化多步遗憾为目标。作者称该框架可提升对昂贵黑盒函数的优化效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.06529v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a powerful paradigm for optimizing expensive black-box functions. Traditional BO methods typically rely on separate hand-crafted acquisition functions and surrogate models for the underlying function, and often operate in a myopic manner. In this paper, we propose a novel direct regret optimization approach that jointly learns the optimal model and non-myopic acquisition by distilling from a set of candidate models and acquisitions, and explicitly targets minimizing the multi-step regret. Our framework leverages…
items.why_zh: 贝叶斯优化是调参、实验设计等昂贵黑盒优化的主流方法，联合学习模型与长视采集函数有望显著提升样本效率。
items.why_en: Bayesian optimization is a mainstream tool for expensive black-box problems, and jointly learning the model with a non-myopic acquisition could substantially improve sample efficiency.

items.title_zh: 十年深度时间序列预测：综述
items.title_en: Deep Time-Series Forecasting in 10 Years: A Survey
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇 arXiv 综述论文（replace-cross 类），系统回顾十年来的深度时间序列预测研究。自相关是时间序列的普遍性质，每个观测都依赖其前序观测，这在深度预测中带来两大核心挑战：一是设计骨干网络架构来建模历史序列中的自相关，二是设计损失函数来建模标签序列中的自相关。尽管近期研究在这两方面均有进展，但尚无同时覆盖两者的系统性综述。本文正是为填补这一空白而写。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.19899v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Autocorrelation is a common property of time-series, where each observation is dependent on its predecessors. In deep time-series forecasting, it raises two central challenges: (1) designing backbone architectures to model autocorrelation in history sequences, and (2) devising loss functions to model autocorrelation in label sequences. Recent studies have made strides in tackling these challenges, but a systematic survey examining both aspects remains lacking. To bridge this gap, this paper reviews deep time-series forecasting from an a…
items.why_zh: 时间序列预测在金融、气象、工业等领域应用广泛，该综述为理解架构与损失设计两条主线提供了统一视角。
items.why_en: Time-series forecasting underpins finance, weather, and industry, and this survey offers a unified view of the architecture and loss-design lines of work.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek接近获得千亿融资，腾讯、宁德时代参与
items.title_en: DeepSeek Nears 100 Billion Yuan Funding Round With Tencent and CATL

items.why_zh: 千亿元级融资将为大模型研发与算力投入提供巨额弹药，也显示产业资本对国产基础模型的强烈信心。
items.why_en: A 100-billion-yuan round would give DeepSeek enormous resources for model and compute investment, signaling strong industrial backing for Chinese foundation models.

items.title_zh: 微软 Surface Laptop Ultra 笔记本规格曝光：最高 128GB 内存，面向 AI 开发和内容创作
items.title_en: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra Specs Leak: Up to 128GB RAM, Aimed at AI Development and Content Creation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 7 日消息，科技媒体 Windows Central 昨日（10 月 6 日）发布博文，分享了微软 Surface Laptop Ultra 笔记本的 2 种规格配置，包含 18 核和 20 核心 RTX Spark 方案，目前尚不清楚具体售价信息。 IT之家援引博文内容，附上相关规格信息如下： 项目 规格 平台／芯片 NVIDIA RTX Spark Superchip，集成 NVIDIA Grace CPU 与 Blackwell RTX GPU，原生支持 CUDA。 处理器选项 18 核 CPU，搭配 5120 核 GPU；20 核 CPU，搭配 6144 核 GPU。 统一内存（RAM） 18 核版本：24 GB 或 32 GB；20 核版本：32 GB、48 GB、64 GB 或 128 GB。 AI 性能 AI 算力最高达 1 PetaFLOP；支持在本地运行参数规模达 1200 亿以上的前沿级模型。 显示屏 15 英寸 PixelSense Ultra 触控屏，HDR 峰值亮度为 2000 尼特，像素密度为 262 PPI，具备高精度色彩表现，支持杜比视界（Dolby Vision）。 尺寸与重量 厚度小于 18 毫米；重量小于 4.5 磅。 触控板与输入 触觉反馈触控板，面积比 15 英寸 Surface Laptop 的触控板大 30% 以上，…
items.summary_en: Windows Central reports two leaked configurations for Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra. It pairs an NVIDIA RTX Spark Superchip (Grace CPU plus Blackwell RTX GPU, native CUDA) with 18-core/5120-core or 20-core/6144-core options, unified memory from 24GB up to 128GB, and up to 1 PetaFLOP of AI compute capable of running frontier models above 120 billion parameters locally. The 15-inch PixelSense Ultra touchscreen offers 2000-nit HDR peak brightness at 262 PPI and Dolby Vision support, in a chassis under 18mm and 4.5 pounds. Pricing is unknown.
items.why_zh: 把 Grace-Blackwell 级算力塞进轻薄笔记本，意味着大模型本地推理正从数据中心走向开发者桌面。
items.why_en: Putting Grace-Blackwell-class compute into a thin laptop signals that large-model local inference is moving from data centers to developers' desks.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek新一轮融资规模目标翻倍 宁德时代、腾讯再参与 DIGITIMES

Exact amount, valuation and deal structure were not disclosed. The raised target reflects growing expectations for DeepSeek's models and commercialization prospects.
items.why_zh: 融资目标翻倍说明资本对大模型赛道的投入意愿仍在快速加码，也关乎 DeepSeek 后续算力与人才竞争。
items.why_en: A doubled target shows capital's willingness to keep scaling bets on foundation models, and matters for DeepSeek's compute and talent race.

items.title_zh: 三星 2026 Q3 营业利润预计同比增长近 9 倍，存储涨价放缓引担忧
items.title_en: Samsung's Q3 Operating Profit Seen Up Nearly Ninefold as Memory Price Hikes Slow
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 7 日消息，受人工智能领域旺盛需求的拉动，三星电子第三季度营业利润预计将增长近九倍；不过自 8 月底以来，分析师已经把该公司盈利预测下调了接近 8%。 尽管存储芯片的涨价势头有所放缓，同时韩元汇率走强，这家全球最大存储芯片厂商 7‑9 月季度的营业利润预期仍达到 106.1 万亿韩元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,260.44 亿元人民币） 。 路孚特（LSEG）的 SmartEstimate 指标综合了 21 位分析师的预测结果，并向过往研判准确度更高的分析师赋予更高权重。自 8 月末以来，该一致预期已经下调 7.7%。 去年同期三星营业利润为 12.17 万亿韩元 （现汇率约合 603.39 亿元人民币） 。本次业绩将是三星连续第四个季度刷新营业利润纪录。这背后反映出，AI 基础设施的需求增速已经超过供给扩张，存储芯片持续处于供货紧张状态。 各家芯片厂商认为，这场始于一年多以前的芯片紧缺局面还将延续至明年，甚至有可能一直持续到 2028 年。 但第三季度芯片涨价的节奏已经放缓。这也引发市场担忧：芯片行业的利润率或许已经见顶，人们开始质疑这一轮 AI 资本开支热潮究竟能够持续多久。 三星将于周四率先发布第三季度的初步业绩，完整详细的数据则会在 10 月下旬对外公布。 在 AI 需求带动长达一年以上的涨价行情过后，投资者正在密切关注存储芯片价格涨势降温这一变化。…
items.summary_en: Samsung's Q3 operating profit is expected to grow nearly ninefold year on year to 106.1 trillion won (about 526 billion yuan), up from 12.17 trillion won a year earlier, driven by AI demand and tight memory supply—a fourth straight quarterly record. Yet memory price increases have slowed since late August, and the LSEG SmartEstimate consensus from 21 analysts has been cut 7.7%, raising fears that industry margins may have peaked and questions about how long the AI capex boom lasts. Preliminary results come Thursday, with full figures in late October.
items.why_zh: 三星业绩是 AI 存储景气度的风向标，涨价放缓则可能预示这轮 AI 硬件超级周期的拐点风险。
items.why_en: Samsung's results are a bellwether for AI memory demand, and slowing price hikes may signal turning-point risk for the AI hardware supercycle.

items.summary_en: Securities Star reports that DeepSeek is considering expanding its latest funding round to 100 billion yuan. Tencent and CATL have been reported as participants, and the round's target has reportedly doubled from the original plan. Final amount, valuation and timing were not disclosed. At that scale it would rank among the largest fundraisings by a Chinese foundation-model company.
items.why_zh: 资金规模直接决定 DeepSeek 在算力、数据与人才上的投入能力，也影响国产大模型的竞争格局。
items.why_en: The size of the round directly shapes DeepSeek's spending on compute, data and talent, and affects the competitive landscape of Chinese foundation models.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉 Robotaxi 应用多国上架，但打车服务仍仅限美国七城
items.title_en: Tesla Robotaxi App Goes Live in More Countries, but Rides Stay Limited to Seven US Cities
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 7 日消息，特斯拉 Robotaxi 应用现已在更多国家开放下载。英国、澳大利亚、德国、意大利、瑞典、新加坡等地的苹果 App Store 以及谷歌 Play 商店都已经上架该软件，后续还会新增更多地区。 不过，现阶段不要以为伦敦或者柏林街头马上就能看到无人驾驶版 Model Y，或是没有方向盘的 Cybercab 上路运营。海外地区开放下载这款应用，主要是方便前往美国旅游的游客，他们到美国之后就可以使用这项自动驾驶打车服务。 现在任何人都可以下载 Robotaxi 应用 IT之家注意到，自从这项服务上线之后，使用权限已经大幅放宽。去年夏天特斯拉刚推出 Robotaxi 测试版服务时，配套 App 仅支持苹果 iOS 系统，而且还需要进入候补名单排队。今年春季早些时候，特斯拉终于发布安卓版本，结束了这款打车 App 长达近一年仅支持 iPhone 的局面。 如今只要下载该应用，并且身处已经开通服务的区域内，任何人都可以直接呼叫自动驾驶车辆。对于国际旅客而言，意味着出行之前就可以在本国把 App 安装完毕。 Robotaxi 运营依旧仅限于美国七座城市 虽然这款 App 已经在数十个国家上架，但打车服务本身并没有同步出海。特斯拉目前的 Robotaxi 服务仅在美国以下七座城市运营：奥斯汀、旧金山、达拉斯、休斯顿、迈阿密、奥兰多、坦帕。 现阶段只有奥斯汀可以呼叫…
items.summary_en: Tesla's Robotaxi app is now downloadable in the UK, Australia, Germany, Italy, Sweden, Singapore and more, with additional regions to come. The ride-hailing service itself still operates only in seven US cities — Austin, San Francisco, Dallas, Houston, Miami, Orlando and Tampa. The wider app rollout mainly helps travelers install it before flying to the US.
items.why_zh: 这说明特斯拉已在应用层面为 Robotaxi 国际化铺路，但真正的自动驾驶载客服务仍未走出美国，扩张瓶颈在监管与运营而非软件。
items.why_en: It shows Tesla is preparing the app layer for Robotaxi's global expansion, yet the actual driverless ride service remains confined to the US, with regulation and operations — not software — the bottleneck.

items.title_zh: 传闻称 OpenAI 一夜解决 722 道数学难题，并取得“准黎曼猜想”证明突破
items.title_en: Mathematics Big Bang: OpenAI Solved 722 Complex Math Problems Overnight – The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis Proven Breakthrough
items.summary_zh: 一则以“数学大爆炸”为题的报道称，OpenAI 在一夜之间解决了 722 道复杂数学问题，并宣称在“准黎曼猜想”上取得证明性突破。目前可获取的信息基本停留在标题层面，未见 OpenAI 官方说明、论文细节或同行评议结果。此前多次出现“AI 攻破重大数学难题”的说法，往往需要更严格的核实。读者宜以原始论文与官方发布为准，谨慎看待相关表述。
items.summary_en: Mathematics Big Bang: OpenAI Solved 722 Complex Math Problems Overnight – The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis Proven Breakthrough 36Kr
items.why_zh: 若属实，将意味着 AI 在数学推理与自动证明上迈出重要一步；但在缺乏论文与验证前，应保持谨慎。
items.why_en: If true, it would mark a major step for AI in mathematical reasoning and automated proof — but without a paper or verification, caution is warranted.

items.summary_en: DeepSeek reportedly plans to double the size of its latest funding round to 100 billion yuan. The claim comes from media reports and has not been officially confirmed, with investors, valuation and terms undisclosed. If completed, it would rank among the largest AI fundraisings in China.

items.why_en: A 100-billion-yuan round would set a new bar for Chinese AI fundraising and could reshape the funding landscape of the large-model race.

items.title_zh: LG 电子 2026 财年第三财季营收 238270 亿韩元，同比增长 8.9%
items.title_en: LG Electronics Posts Q3 FY2026 Revenue of 238.27 Trillion Won, Up 8.9% YoY
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 7 日消息，LG 电子今日发布 2026 财年（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 12 月）第三财季（2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）业绩快报报告： 营业总收入 ：238,270 亿韩元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,181.34 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 8.9%，环比持平 营业利润 ：7,818 亿韩元 （现汇率约合 38.76 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 13.5%，环比下降 50.5% AI 解读 本次 LG 电子 2026 财年第三财季业绩快报，整体业绩符合市场预期。 公司主营业务 LG 电子是韩国知名消费电子及家电企业，主营业务涵盖生活家电、显示器件、车辆电子解决方案、数码产品等多个领域，在全球消费电子市场拥有较高品牌影响力。 财报核心数据 当季营业收入达到 238,270 亿韩元 （现汇率约合 1,181.34 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 8.9%，环比变动 0%；累计前三季度营业收入达到 713,807 亿韩元 （现汇率约合 3,539.06 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 9.2%。 当季营业利润为 7,818 亿韩元 （现汇率约合 38.76 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 13.5%，环比下降 50.5%；累计前三季度营业利润达到 40,346 亿韩元 （现汇率约合 200.04 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 55.9%。 业绩说明与未来展望 本…
items.summary_en: LG Electronics reported Q3 FY2026 (July–September) revenue of 238,270 billion won, up 8.9% year on year and roughly flat quarter on quarter. Operating profit came in at 7,818 billion won, up 13.5% YoY but down 50.5% QoQ. Nine-month revenue rose 9.2% to 713,807 billion won and operating profit jumped 55.9% to 40,346 billion won, with results broadly in line with market expectations.
items.why_zh: 作为全球消费电子与家电巨头，LG 电子的营收与利润走势是观察消费电子需求及 AI 家电趋势的重要风向标。
items.why_en: As a global consumer-electronics and appliance giant, LG's revenue and profit trends are a key gauge of consumer electronics demand and the AI appliance cycle.
